p: on our side: He shows that God was ready to help at need and that there was no other way to be saved, but by this means alone.
quick: So unable were we to resist.
waters had overwhelmed us: He uses proper similitudes to express the great danger that the Church was in, and out of which God miraculously delivered them.
snare of the fowlers: For the wicked not only furiously rage against the faithful, but craftily imagined to destroy them.
